## What you will do

Compare cytoskeletal gene families across tissues, locate drugs in experimental
structures, and read a clinical-trial record. Build a parameterised R Markdown
report with a tissue heatmap and a trial-phase chart. **ELO 6, 9.**

Builds on [actin](../actin/lec.qmd), [microtubules](../microtubules/lec.qmd), and
[myosin and intermediate filaments](../myosin-if/lec.qmd). Allow about 3–4 hours.

1. [In the browser: structures, variants and trials](browser.qmd).
2. [In R: tissue expression and trial records](report.qmd).

## Before you start

No account is needed. Use RStudio or R with `rmarkdown`, `ggplot2`, `jsonlite` and
`httr2` installed. Install missing packages once in the console:

```r
install.packages(c("rmarkdown", "ggplot2", "jsonlite", "httr2"))
```

Download the report and all listed snapshots. Put the report in a new folder and
CSV/JSON files in its `data/` subfolder. Keep the filenames. If an API is unavailable,
set `use_snapshot <- TRUE`. A snapshot is a dated copy of real records, not simulated data.
Knitting uses a fresh R session: create every object in the report and finish with
`sessionInfo()`. Do not include your R console history as a substitute for code.

## Downloads

- [Student report](bioinfo-cytoskeleton.Rmd)
- [GTEx expression snapshot](data/gtex-expression-2026-11-18.csv)
- [Mavacamten trial snapshot](data/mavacamten-trials-2026-11-18.csv)
- [Retrieval record](data/retrieval-manifest-2026-11-18.json)

For a second gene set, use the supplied tubulin isotypes TUBB, TUBB3 and TUBB4A.
The snapshot contains these in addition to the 13 core genes.

## Sources and licences

GTEx v8, adult tissue median RNA expression (TPM), from the
[GTEx API](https://gtexportal.org/api/v2/); cite the GTEx Consortium,
*Science* 369:1318–1330 (2020), [doi:10.1126/science.aaz1776](https://doi.org/10.1126/science.aaz1776).
Use only open summary data here; donor-level controlled data are not included.
[ClinicalTrials.gov](https://clinicaltrials.gov/data-api/api) supplies public registry
records, retrieved 2026-11-18. RCSB PDB coordinates are CC0; no external images are copied.
